profile_text.body:
Dale Lane runs Machine Learning for Kids as an independent project at machinelearningforkids.co.uk. The site describes it as an educational tool for teaching kids about machine learning by letting them train a computer to recognise text, pictures, numbers, or sounds, and then make things with it in tools like Scratch.

The project is tracked as an education and research AI product, with model training as its AI element and Scratch-based machine learning projects as its use. Its stated audience is students and teachers, and it is listed as free. The record notes that it was found in the research for The AI Ready School and has not been independently verified, that student age and privacy details are not verified, and that the source is secondary only.
